summary: Prove exact PTY start rejection before any launcher can exist

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. Previously unverified producer outcomes are not reclassified.

schema.detail: No persisted schema change; uses existing operation-bound native rejection witnesses.

rules.detail: A fresh guarded start refused before launch can release admission without controlling an unrelated PTY. Earlier publication fences, retries, launcher timeouts and publication failures remain unverified.

compatibility.detail: No client or producer protocol changes. Reconcile-pass completion and retirement observations use the shared PTY snapshot; launch-boundary checks retain their spawn-lock fencing.

manual.detail: No manual action. This change does not provide missing proof for historical producer-open starts.

recovery.detail: Closure requires an exact operation-bound nonlaunch witness; generic errors, foreign PTY tags and elapsed time are not proof.
